week_rule: Saturday through Friday; column label is Friday week-ending date
html_companion: Income_Plan_Pattern_A_B_Simulation.html is visualization only and is not a runtime dependency
banned_in_tests: Do not use live household tickers as fixture names

goldens.name: table1_has_no_last_update
goldens.expect: Pattern A Table 1 column set is label, year summary, week columns only

goldens.name: table2_last_update_replaces_qty_total_annual
goldens.expect: Pattern A Table 2 frozen columns are symbol, last_update, then weeks. No quantity, no ytd_total, no annual_pct

goldens.name: plan_lock_past_weeks
goldens.given: WEEK1 qty 100 Car; week ending 2026-08-14 is closed; current plan is 0.17

goldens.name: monthly_only_pay_week
goldens.expect: MON1 has plan $ only in week ending 2026-08-28; other weeks empty not red

goldens.name: future_actual_blank
goldens.expect: Table 1 Total Actual and Total Difference for week ending 2026-09-11 are null, not 0

goldens.name: account_filter_car_only
goldens.expect: Selecting Car only removes Income/Health/Roth/9 rows from Table 1 and drops non-Car lots from Table 2 $

goldens.name: week_nav_a_to_b_to_a
goldens.expect: Opening week 2026-09-04 from Table 1 header shows Pattern B for that week; Back restores Pattern A with 2026-09-04 selected

goldens.name: last_update_success_only
goldens.given: WEEK1 last collector attempt failed; no prior success

goldens.name: default_accounts_exclude_speculation
goldens.expect: Initial Pattern A account set does not include Speculation, Energy, Robinhood

goldens.name: html_not_imported
goldens.expect: Repo production path does not add the companion HTML as a shipped runtime asset

goldens.name: pdf_pattern_a_contains_both_tables_not_b
goldens.expect: Save PDF while Pattern A is active includes account rollup and position grid and does not include Pattern B declaration/actual columns

goldens.name: pdf_pattern_b_single_week
goldens.expect: Save PDF while Pattern B week ending 2026-09-04 is active is that week only

goldens.name: print_respects_car_filter
goldens.expect: Car-only on screen is Car-only on PDF and Excel

goldens.name: excel_future_actual_blank
goldens.expect: Future Actual and Difference cells in Excel are empty, not 0

goldens.name: excel_table1_no_last_update
goldens.expect: AccountRollup sheet has no last_update column

goldens.name: excel_table2_has_last_update_not_qty
goldens.expect: PositionGrid sheet has last_update and does not have quantity, ytd_total, or annual_pct

goldens.name: file_menu_delegates
goldens.expect: File Print current view while Income Plan focused uses the same snapshot as the page Print / Export control

goldens.name: html_not_print_engine
goldens.expect: Print path does not invoke Income_Plan_Pattern_A_B_Simulation.html

goldens.name: pdf_write_local_first
goldens.expect: Default PDF destination is local filesystem, not cloud Drive

goldens.name: cover_lists_filter_state
goldens.expect: PDF and Excel cover/header list pattern, selected accounts, and week window
